title: Restricted width bounded by the maximum
statement: Let $C$ be a depth circuit, let $\rho$ assign each input coordinate one of the states free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$, and let $i$ index a first-layer gate. The restricted gate width of gate $i$ under $\rho$ is at most the maximum restricted width of the first-layer gates under $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: An index i of a first-layer gate
